preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The sum of the elements in the array is between 0 and 200, inclusive.
The sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements is between 0 and 2000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.count == n and sum(output) == s and sum(abs(a - b) for i, a in enumerate(output) for b in output[i:]) == k)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a lexicographically smallest array of non-negative integers that satisfies the sum of elements and the sum of absolute differences conditions.
